title_original: 지방자치단체 전자인사관리시스템 구축ㆍ운영 등에 관한 규정
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 25751, November 19, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That among the Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 5 of this Addendum, amendments to Presidential Decrees promulgated before the enforcement of this Decree but not yet in force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <229> Omitted.

<230> The Regulations on Establishment and Operation of Electronic Personnel Management Systems of Local Governments shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, subparagraphs 2 through 4; Article 4 (1), the proviso to paragraph (2), and paragraph (4) of the same Article; Article 5 (1) and (2); the main sentence and proviso to the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 6 (1), paragraphs (2) and (3) of the same Article; Article 8; and Article 9 (1) and (2), respectively, "Minister of Security and Public Administration" shall be replaced with "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs."

<231> through <418> Omitted.
